refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.subtitle: Refunds of account credit to the payer's verified bank account
refunds.emptyPendingBody: A refund above the auto-approval limit will appear here for the billing manager.
refunds.emptyAllBody: Propose a refund from a billing account that holds a credit.

detail.title: Refund
detail.payeeNote: The payee is the payer of the billing account. The refund goes to a verified bank account; the full IBAN is never shown.

netting.title: Netting
netting.none: Nothing was netted against open amounts.

decision.title: Decision
decision.decidedBody: The decision is recorded. An approved refund goes to disbursement.
decision.makerNote: You proposed this refund. Another approver must decide it.
decision.roleNote: Only the billing manager decides refunds above the auto-approval limit.
decision.notPending: This refund is not awaiting a decision.

resubmit.title: Resubmit
resubmit.intro: A rejected or returned refund can be proposed again, optionally to a corrected bank account.
resubmit.failed: The refund could not be resubmitted
resubmit.needPayee: Save the new bank account first, or clear the option.

payee.intro: Enter the payer's bank account for refunds. It is checked against the account holder's name. Only the last four characters are shown afterwards.
payee.changeNote: This replaces the previous account, so a second approver and a waiting period apply.
payee.failed: The bank account could not be saved

propose.title: Refund of credit
propose.intro: Pays the credit on this account back to the payer, after netting against open invoices.
propose.noCredit: This account holds no credit to refund.
propose.defaultPayee: The refund goes to the payer's verified bank account.
propose.differentPayee: Pay to a different bank account
propose.needPayee: Save the new bank account first, or clear the option.
propose.failed: The refund could not be proposed

approvalNote.NOT_REQUIRED: Within the auto-approval limit: no approval needed.
approvalNote.PENDING: Above the auto-approval limit: the billing manager must approve it.

creditNote.title: Credit note
creditNote.bannerBody: This credit note corrects an earlier invoice. It reduces what the customer owes and can be refunded as account credit.
